text:
Maya (People Ops): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: two asks we heard a lot - (1) exact dates for the review window, (2) practical steps for off-cycle raises. dropping concise answers here.

Jon (CTO): appreciate this. managers need something bite-sized to share in 1:1s.

Eli (Eng Manager): yes please - also: new hire promo eligibility?

Maya (People Ops): short version: self-reviews close 2026-06-01 EOD PT. manager reviews 2026-06-03 -> 2026-06-09. calibration meetings 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-12. retro/appeals window opens 2026-06-13 -> 2026-06-18.

Sam (People Ops): off-cycle raises: allowed for retention or role-change. submit the "adjustment form" (intra link in resources). require Manager + Director signoff; >5% comp change also needs Finance approval. aim to keep off-cycle exceptions rare.

Eli (Eng Manager): new hires: can someone hired within probation be nominated?

Maya (People Ops): new hires typically wait one full cycle unless PM/EM certifies exceptional ramp + impact. use the hire-adjust flow and tag recruiting + People Ops to fast-track.

Jon (CTO): any guardrails we should flag publicly?

Sam (People Ops): fairness guardrails: off-cycle promotions should be under 6% of an org. we will flag high concentration in calibration and may decline to keep parity. retro pay processed next payroll after approval (expect 1-2 pay cycles).

PayrollBot: Reminder scheduled - "People Ops calibration office hours" 2026-05-19 16:00 PT.

Maya (People Ops): will post a one-page cheatsheet and a manager justification template in #people-ops-resources in 30m. DM if you have sensitive cases and we will slot you into office hours.
